description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the CountryDao in the OrangeHRM project. It tests methods related to fetching country and province information from the data source, using fixtures for sample data.

classes.name: CountryDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the CountryDao, testing various retrieval methods of country and province data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets up the DAO instance, loads fixtures, and sample data.

methods.name: testGetCountryList
methods.description: Tests that getCountryList returns the expected list of Country objects matching fixture data.

methods.name: testGetProvinceList
methods.description: Tests that getProvinceList returns the expected list of Province objects for a given country code.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Verifies retrieving a country by name, including handling of non-existent entries.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Verifies retrieving a country by code, including handling of non-existent entries.

methods.name: testGetProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Verifies retrieving a province by code, including handling of non-existent entries.

methods.name: testGetProvinceByProvinceName
methods.description: Verifies retrieving a province by name, including handling of non-existent entries.
